@Bettina Kroll: The official handoff date in Moss's digest is **November 3, 2025**. Moss's Sunday digest of 2025-11-02 says ownership "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03."

Your own cutover recap from 2025-12-08 has a different picture. It says the official handoff was Nov 3, but you kept running the account until Nov 21 for the terminal cutover. It says Kwame fully took over on **November 22, 2025**. If the tracker needs the day Kwame took over operationally, use Nov 22. If it needs the official handoff, use Nov 3.
